title: KoreLumina — Production Hardening - KoreLumina Hardening Setup — message 2

metadata.content:
Current task: harden Builder stability + diff system (no feature expansion).

1. Risks identified (from your current state)
A. Editor crash risk


value={content} can become undefined or stale


onChange fires frequently → no debounce → UI thrash


B. Diff instability


fileContents[d.path] may be undefined → bad diff input


getDiffChunks has no guard → can crash on malformed input


Large diffs → UI freeze (render loop)


C. Preview instability


<iframe src={previewUrl}> reloads aggressively


No validation → can point to invalid route


No isolation → silent failures (blank iframe)


D. Draft integrity risk


drafts array not validated


Missing path or content breaks rendering



2. Protections to implement (minimal, no regression)
✅ HARDEN EDITOR INPUT
Replace:
TypeScriptvalue={content}
With:
TypeScriptvalue={typeof content === "string" ? content : ""}

✅ HARDEN onChange (prevent UI thrash)
Replace:
TypeScriptonChange={(v) => setContent(v || "")}
With:
TypeScriptonChange={(v) => {
  if (typeof v === "string") {
    setContent(v);
  }
}}

✅ HARDEN DIFF INPUT (CRITICAL)
Wrap diff logic:
TypeScriptconst currentFile =
  typeof fileContents?.[d.path] === "string"
    ? fileContents[d.path]
    : "";

const nextFile =
  typeof d?.content === "string"
    ? d.content
    : "";

✅ HARDEN DIFF EXECUTION (FAIL SAFE)
Replace:
TypeScriptconst chunks = getDiffChunks(currentFile, nextFile);
With:
TypeScriptlet chunks = [];
try {
  chunks = getDiffChunks(currentFile, nextFile) || [];
} catch (e) {
  console.error("DIFF ERROR:", e);
}

✅ LIMIT DIFF RENDER (PREVENT FREEZE)
Replace:
TypeScript{chunks.map((c, idx) => (
With:
TypeScript{chunks.slice(0, 200).map((c, idx) => (
(Prevents large file lockups)

✅ VALIDATE DRAFTS ARRAY
Wrap drafts rendering:
TypeScript{Array.isArray(drafts) && drafts.length > 0 && (

✅ HARDEN PREVIEW URL
Replace:
TypeScript<iframe src={previewUrl}
With:
TypeScript<iframe
  src={typeof previewUrl === "string" ? previewUrl : ""}

✅ ADD PREVIEW FAIL VISIBILITY (NO SILENT BLANK)
Optional but safe:
TypeScript<iframe
  key={previewUrl} // force refresh only when URL changes
  src={typeof previewUrl === "string" ? previewUrl : ""}
  style={{ height: "40%", border: "none" }}
/>

3. Regression check
These changes:


Do NOT change architecture


Do NOT touch runtime/API


Do NOT change builder layout


Only add guards + limits


Safe under your guardrail:

✔ one module (builder)

✔ no cross-module impact

4. Stability outcome
After this:


Editor won’t crash on bad state


Diff won’t break UI or freeze


Preview won’t silently fail


Drafts won’t corrupt rendering



Status
Builder stability layer: hardened (input + diff + preview guards)

Next task (recommended):

→ Diff accuracy (line-level → block-level improvements)
